item.title: Lendlease Global Commercial REIT assumes full ownership of PLQ Mall with purchase of 30% stake
item.description: Lendlease Global Commercial REIT (Lendlease REIT) is buying the remaining 30% it does not already own in PLQ Mall from Lendlease Group. In a Feb 25 announcement, the REIT’s manager says it is acquiring 30% of the issued units in PLQM Trust, which holds 100% interest in the property. item.title: Tan Boon Liat Building launches second collective sale tender at reduced price of $1 bil
item.description: Tan Boon Liat Building, an industrial property at 315 Outram Road, has been launched for collective sale by public tender with a reserve price of $1 billion. This is the second en bloc attempt by owners, who had put the development up for tender in February of last year with a reserve price of $1.15 billion. item.title: URA launches tender for second Holland Plain GLS site; Morrison Lane plot available for application
item.description: URA has launched the tender for a residential Government Land Sale (GLS) site at Holland Plain. The 99-year leasehold site spans 16,9175 sq ft and can yield about 280 housing units. The tender for the site will close on May 7. The site is the second plot to be launched in the upcoming Holland Plain residential precinct, says Mark Yip, CEO of Huttons Asia. item.title: Cheong family's Oxley Rise mansion: Receivers offer one-seventh stake for sale
item.description: Receivers have put a one-seventh interest in the hilltop property at 5 Oxley Rise up for sale by tender, ERA Realty Network announced on Feb 25 as the sole and exclusive marketing agent, without disclosing an indicative price. In a receivership sale, a court-appointed receiver takes control of an asset to sell it to recover funds, often on behalf of a lender.
